0022600197.text: The Pistons (6-2, 1st in the Central, 2nd in the East) are at home against the Lakers (7-2, 1st in the Pacific, 2nd in the West), with Detroit coming off a one-game losing streak and Los Angeles riding a three-game win streak. Detroit will be without Jalen Duren (hamstring strain) and Isaiah Joe (hip bruise), both listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Pistons swept the Lakers 2-0 in 2025-26, including a 113-110 win in Detroit on March 23, 2026.
